top_signals.title: Nides Says Iran War Needs Negotiations
top_signals.summary: Former US Ambassador to Israel Tom Nides says there is no lasting military solution to the conflict with Iran, arguing that renewed negotiations involving regional allies offer the only realistic path to reopening the Strait of Hormuz and addressing Tehran's nuclear program. He also says regime change in Iran is not a practical near-term objective and that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces growing domestic political pressure as the conflict continues without a clear resolution. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Finland to disconnect fiber-optic link to Russia as lease expires
top_signals.summary: Finland stopped power transmissions with Russia at the start of the war in Ukraine, and two related telecom connections will stop at the end of this year, authorities said.
